# Chandrabhan Mahato

> Frontend / Full-Stack Developer based in Chhattisgarh, India. Building modern web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and AI integrations.

## Overview
Chandrabhan Mahato is a Software Developer (B.Tech CSE) specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and AI-assisted development (Gemini, Genkit, Ollama). He builds scalable web applications, interactive AI developer environments, and full-stack solutions.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML/CSS
- **Backend & Data**: Python, Django, Flask, Node.js, Firebase, Firestore
- **AI & GenAI Integration**: Gemini API, Firebase Genkit, Ollama, AI-assisted workflows
- **Developer Tools**: Git/GitHub, Electron, Monaco Editor, Vercel

## Featured Projects
- **CaramelPepper**: AI Coding Environment built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Firebase, Electron, Genkit, and Monaco Editor. (Live: https://caramelpepper.vercel.app | Repo: https://github.com/NotBhan/caramelpepper)
- **ExamPrep AI**: AI Study Platform transforming syllabi into structured study tools, topic organization, quizzes, and AI tutoring. (Live: https://examprep-ai-five.vercel.app | Repo: https://github.com/NotBhan/examprep-ai)
- **StudentVoice**: Campus Feedback Platform connecting anonymous student reports with admin workflows and AI analysis. (Live: https://student-voice-sigma.vercel.app | Repo: https://github.com/NotBhan/team-epicode--student-voice)
